name: Heat Critical Strike Table

legend.key: ßπ = must parry ß rounds; ß∏ = no parry for ß rounds; ß∑ = stunned for ß rounds; ß∫ = bleed ß hits per round; (-ß) = foe has -ß penalty; (+ß) = attacker gets +ß next round.
legend.rounds: M(-ß) / M(+ß) = the penalty/bonus lasts M rounds. A bare symbol = 1 round.
legend.none: "—" = no mechanical effect beyond the text (often death).
legend.variants: Conditional cells (e.g. "with helmet / w/o helmet") apply the matching variant.

rollMatchPolicy: rollMin / rollMax are inclusive on an UNMODIFIED d100. The first band (rollMin=null) is the low catch-all; rolls above 100 (modified criticals) clamp to the top band.

A.text: The air around foe shimmers. Pfft.

B.text: Attack is wild and boils nearby water.

C.text: Hot smoke makes foe's eyes red.

D.text: Foe evades the embrace of the flames.

E.text: Foe avoids the blast but not the heat.

B.text: Singe foe's exposed skin. The heat dies quick. Foe is not impressed.

C.text: Sparks and smoke dance all over foe. He waves them off with little effort.

D.text: Flames surround foe. He seems to step out of them unharmed.

E.text: Sweltering heat reaches out for foe. He evades. You have initiative.

A.text: Foe covers his face and leaps aside. You have initiative.

B.text: Foe simmers in his clothes. He is unfocused and you have initiative.

C.text: Foe suspects that he is on fire. He is wrong. You gain the initiative.

D.text: Foe is enshrouded by smoke. The heat harms him little. You have initiative.

E.text: Flash unbalances foe and sends him on the defensive. You have initiative.

A.text: Blast stings foe's hands and arms. You have the initiative.

B.text: Assault blinds foe for a moment. You have 2 rounds of initiative.

C.text: Hair and bowstrings are singed. You have 2 rounds of initiative.

D.text: Foe strikes out at the flames to protect himself. It seems to work well enough.

E.text: Foe fails to avoid some of the attack and almost falls down.

A.text: Foe's chest and side heat up and garments smolder from assault. He will be easily kindled if you strike again.

B.text: Fire laden blast forces foe back. Any containers of water boil and burst open. You have 2 rounds of initiative.

C.text: Disorient foe with a tricky shot. Garments smolder suspiciously. He checks them carefully; guard is still up.

D.text: With a burst of flame, you cover foe with heated air. Foe jumps back to avoid any additional wounds.

E.text: Blister foe's weapon arm. He gives ground to escape the heat. His footing is better than you had hoped.

A.text: Hot winds dance around foe parching his exposed skin. He puts up a desperate defence.

B.text: Foe's shield side is swathed in fire. He may use a shield to avoid the attack, but it combusts. Shield hand is burned.

C.text: Heat catches foe in lower leg. You gain initiative while foe regains his balance. The pain stays with him.

D.text: Cover foe with a flash fire. Exposed skin burns. The flames bite deep and the pain is great.

E.text: Strike to side and back ignite foe's cloak and pack. Neck and shoulder are lightly burned.

A.text: Clothes smoke, then burn. Foe flails his arms trying to put them out. The pain endures longer than the flames.

B.text: Foe evades most of the damage with some grace. The remainder scorches his side lightly.

C.text: Flame spreads up foe's side and snaps at his arm and face. Exposed areas are lightly burned.

D.text: Assault lands on foe's weapon arm. He makes a supreme effort to pull his arm away. Foe is unable to protect himself.

E.text: Foe blocks flames with his weapon. A wooden weapon is destroyed. A metal weapon becomes too hot to hold.

A.text: Spark sets a piece of foe's equipment on fire. Foe must remove the item.

B.text: Foe ducks; attack torches back and the ground behind him. He is shaken.

C.text: Hard strike to side, armor does not help. Blow leaves a blistering mark.

D.text: Foe is aflame and takes damage for 3 rounds while he burns.

E.text: Your flames reach out. Foe frantically leaps back. His chest is burned.

A.text: Assault ignites foe's back. Equipment crackles as it burns and falls clear.

B.text: Engulf foe in flame and smoke. The flames die down; foe escapes death.

C.text: Strong blast hits foe in legs; they nearly give with pain. He recoils 5 ft.

D.text: Flames dance around foe's head. He seeks to get clear and almost falls.

E.text: Garments over foe's shoulders and head are set afire. He is frantic.

A.text: Well placed. Strike slams into foe's weapon arm. Garments are burned. Foe's evasion is comical.

B.text: Concentrated strike burns through foe's leg. The flames do not last but foe's skin is exposed. Skin blisters.

C.text: Flames burst against foe's side. He stumbles but does not fall. He tries to smother the fire with his garments.

D.text: Foe's shield arm and shield are on fire. Dropping the shield only helps a little. The flames cling to his garments.

E.text: Searing strike to foe's legs. Exposed skin and muscle is burned. Infection will follow. Foe struggles to stay up.

A.text: Flame grapples foe's shield and chest. The wound is grave and infection will follow.

B.text: Fire lands along side foe's face. His hair, cheek, and ear are engulfed. Foe throws himself to the ground.

C.text: Blaze consumes garments on weapon arm. Any metal covering heats up. Foe falls from the blast.

D.text: Foe's face and weapon hand are scalded. Foe is having trouble opening his eyes.

E.text: Foe's combustible garments turn him into a torch. He runs a short distance, drops and dies in 6 rounds.

A.text: Toast foe's side and send him stumbling back 5 feet away from you. He blocks his face against any renewed assault.

B.text: Flames seek out foe with a predator's lust. He throws garments and equipment off frantically to satisfy the blaze. Foe is busy staying alive.

C.text: Back blast. Foe drops to one knee and then rises again with some difficulty. Some of his garments still smoke from the assault. Skin is blistered badly.

D.text: Foe leaps back from your deadly inferno. He escapes death but falls on his back. He is prone for 1 round. Minor arm burns.

E.text: Blast leaps onto foe's shield arm. Any shield foe has and his arm are on fire. The heat penetrates deep and foe's face shows it.

A.text: Fire consumes garments and hair. Blinding smoke keeps foe's defenses poorly aligned.

B.text: Chest and arm blast damages organic armor and engulfs any wood on foe. Metal armor heats up painfully.

C.text: Chest blast. Organic armor is destroyed. Metal armor should be removed quickly.

D.text: Foe's weapon arm is a conflagration. Hand and arm are useless. Muscles and nerves are damaged.

E.text: Strike center of foe's chest. Flame spills in all directions. Foe is knocked down. Chest armor is destroyed.

A.text: Foe's shield side is engulfed in flame. Foe's shield is kindled if wooden.

B.text: Abdomen entangled in flames. The flames will spread upward next turn if not extinguished. Foe sees the danger.

C.text: Strike engulfs foe's most exposed hand and burns it without mercy. Hand is useless. Arm clothing is destroyed.

D.text: Foe's side is ignited by your strike and the wounds are deep. He smothers the fire but the damage is done.

E.text: Blast lands on foe's side but spreads to arms and legs. A shield prevents arm damage but his hands are burned off.

A.text: Foe exposes his back while evading the strike. Blast scorches a small wound in his shoulder blade.

B.text: Strike knocks foe down on his back. The flames do not endure but much equipment is burned or crushed.

C.text: Violent inferno destroys organic armor and ruins metal armor on leg. Much of the blast tumbles clear after impact.

D.text: Foe's arms and chest embrace your infernal strike. Arms are useless and foe's skin is open to the air.

E.text: Foe inhales flames scalding lungs and throat. Foe is active for 12 rounds (while he burns), then dies.

A.text: Assault to foe's lower leg consumes covering. Foe falls down. One leg is on fire.

B.text: Leg covering is set on fire by blast. It spreads quickly and foe is in trouble. The flames will grow if not put out.

C.text: Foe's shield side is devoured by flames. Head, arm, side, and leg have critical burns. If foe has a shield, it is destroyed in place of his arm.

D.text: Blast engulfs lower half of foe's body. If foe has abdominal armor, he is knocked out. If not, he dies in 12 inactive rounds from organ damage.

E.text: Foe's lower body is badly burned. Nerves, organs and tissue destroyed. Foe is paralyzed and will die in 9 rounds from shock and dehydration.

A.text: Blow to foe's head. If he has helmet it heats up like a furnace and must be painfully removed. Foe's ears and cheeks are burned.

B.text: Head strike. Force of blast removes any helmet worn. Hair, scalp and skin burn. Smoke and flame blind foe for 3 rounds.

C.text: Trapped in the furnace of your blast, foe is overcome and falls down. He is unconscious and still burning.

D.text: Flames assault upper body. If foe has a full helm, he is blinded and in a coma for 2 days. If not, he dies in 6 rounds due to shock and brain damage.

E.text: Foe is cremated before your very eyes. He remains standing for 6 rounds and then drops and dies. A small fire lingers over the remains. A horrible end.

A.text: Blast lands on the weapon arm and climbs up to foe's neck. It burns all it touches. If foe has any organic neck covering it is destroyed.

B.text: Flames burn into foe's throat. The damage is frightening. Foe's neck collapses in the flames. He drops and dies in 9 inactive rounds. He smells bad.

C.text: Intense heat fuses metal, cloth and skin. Foe is unrecognizable. If no chest armor he is dead instantly. Otherwise he dies after 9 rounds of burning.

D.text: Foe is trapped in the furnace made by your attack. Organs are destroyed and foe's blood boils. He has no hope of survival and dies in 6 inactive rounds.

E.text: Your foe is devoured by a hellfire of which even you are frightened. All combustibles within 10 ft ignite. Little will remain when the fire dies.

A.text: Brutally scar the side of foe's face. Foe is knocked out. He loses 50 from his Appearance and 25 from his Presence.

B.text: Assault consumes clothing and tissue. Foe's arms and chest are without skin. Foe is paralyzed. Infection will follow.

C.text: Strike to foe's head. If he has a helmet, his head is broiled and he dies in 2 rounds. If no helmet he dies instantly.

D.text: Every part of foe is ablaze. He dies in 2 rounds, making terrifying noises. He continues to burn for 12 rounds.

E.text: Fire devours every part of foe in an instant. Bits of metal, teeth and a few bones shower to the ground.
